item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Peaky
  • 発売日: 2015-07-17
  • スコア: 5.529999999999999/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 僕のフタナリ彼女！ ～絶倫少女と純情少年～
  • 英語名: Boku no Futanari Kanojo! Zetsurin Shoujo to Junjou Shounen

あらすじ

The main character “Kazuya Yamano” is touched by the kindness of “Aoi Kannagawa” and falls in love with her. One day, Kazuya confesses his feelings to Aoi, but her reply is ambiguous. The reason is that Aoi is a hermaphrodite and she is conflicted about her own gender.

item.description:

  • ブランド: Peaky

  • スコア: 5.3100000000000005/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 復讐の教室 罠に墜ちた少女『恭子』
  • 英語名: Fukushuu no Kyoushitsu Wana ni Ochita Shoujo “Kyouko”

あらすじ

Kyouko was the popular kid in class.

But one day, after accidentally peeing during class, she becomes the target of bullying.

The girls treat her like a toy, forcing her to climax in the bathroom,

and the boys in her class rape her…

What will become of Kyouko?..
